about_the_game:
Welcome, apprentice, to your new job.

You're probably wondering what you're doing here, and I understand. But right now I need you to put your feelings of confusion and fear aside, I have a very important task. Before me are the memories of five recently-deceased individuals... it is your job to figure out where they should go.

View the memories of the dead.

They're out of order, unfortunately. It's up to you to piece them all together.

Discover the truth.

The truth isn't often pretty, but that's why I need you around.

And don't worry.

Everything is going to be just fine.
